parameters.ordering_rule: deterministic capture-order proxy: (source file capture date, Original_Index). Within one file this is the file's own data-row order; no sort is applied and Timestamp is never an ordering key.

equivalence_with_published_T5.note: The generalised T-sweep code must reproduce the frozen T=5 measurement exactly. Any mismatch invalidates the cross-T comparison.

definitions.T: Window size: the number of consecutive rows per non-overlapping window.
definitions.window: Non-overlapping group of T consecutive rows in the deterministic capture-order proxy: window i holds sequence positions [T*i, T*i+T). Trailing rows that cannot fill a window are discarded.
definitions.identity: 'src_dst_ip_pair' = the exact (Src IP, Dst IP) pair, available only in the 84-column variant. 'dst_port_protocol' = the (Dst Port, Protocol) pair, available in every file. The proxy is a service-level key, not a conversation key: distinct host pairs talking to the same port collapse onto one proxy value, so proxy continuity is an upper bound on real endpoint continuity, never a substitute for it.
definitions.A_pct_windows_all_same_key: Percentage of windows whose T rows all share one identity value (n_unique_keys == 1). Generalises metric A from the T=5 experiment.
definitions.B_pct_windows_any_adjacent_same_key: Percentage of windows with at least one adjacent position j in {0..T-2} where row j and row j+1 share the identity value. Generalises metric B. Note B is structurally easier to satisfy as T grows, because it asks whether any 1 of T-1 links collides.
definitions.C_mean_unique_keys_per_window: Mean of n_unique_keys over all windows; range 1..T.
definitions.D_median_unique_keys_per_window: Median of n_unique_keys over all windows.
definitions.pct_windows_fully_heterogeneous: Percentage of windows with n_unique_keys == T, i.e. no two rows in the window share the identity value. This is the T-generalisation of the '5 distinct pairs' figure.
definitions.pct_adjacent_links_sharing_key: Share of all n_windows*(T-1) adjacent links whose two rows share the identity value. Unlike B this does not saturate as T grows, so it is the adjacency measure that can be compared across window sizes.
definitions.F_pct_windows_label_pure: Percentage of windows whose T labels are identical.
definitions.G_pct_windows_final_label_ne_majority: Percentage of windows where the final (T-th) row's label differs from the window's majority label. Ties are broken by ascending label string, so the measure is deterministic and conservative.
definitions.span_seconds: max(parsed Timestamp) - min(parsed Timestamp) over the window's T rows, in seconds. Diagnostic only: Timestamp never orders rows. A window containing an unparseable timestamp is excluded from span statistics only.
definitions.pct_windows_with_span_at_most: Cumulative share of span-valid windows at or below each threshold in seconds. Reported because the span distribution is bimodal, so a median describes neither mode.
definitions.random_baseline: The identical rows regrouped into windows of T by a seeded permutation and measured with the same code. Row content and marginal distributions are held fixed, so a difference isolates the effect of consecutive adjacency. Never used for training or splitting.

representativeness.caveat: Measured on the (Dst Port, Protocol) proxy because the other files carry no endpoint identifiers. The proxy is a service-level key, so these values are not comparable to the true-identity numbers; only the *relative position* of the reference file within this distribution is.

A_pct_windows_all_same_key.position: within the spread of the other files

proxy_calibration.note: Both identities measured on the same rows with the same code. The proxy collapses distinct host pairs that share a destination service, so it reports more continuity than actually exists at the endpoint level.

cost_arithmetic.note: Arithmetic on the measured window count, not a measured model cost. Assumes one graph per window with T flow nodes.
